title: Virtua Fighter Crossroads Game Streams Character Overview Trailer
content: Sega revealed a character overview trailer for its Virtua Fighter Crossroads game on Tuesday exploring the staff's behind-the-scenes character creation process. The game will launch in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Bananya Franchise Gets Cat-Collecting Mobile Game for Release in Summer
content: TMS announced on Monday it is partnering with Crunchyroll to launch the Bananya Buddies mobile game, inspired by the Bananya character, for iOS and Android this summer exclusively on the Crunchyroll Game Vault. The is available for pre-registration on Google Play now.
author: ANN

title: Studio Ghibli’s Masterpiece, Spirited Away Confirms New Stage Adaptation Release in North America
content: Even several decades since it was established, Studio Ghibli remains one of the most iconic animation studios of all time. Ever since its establishment in 1985, every film released under its banner has been praised for its striking visuals, rich storytelling, and deep emotional impact.
author: ComicBook

title: HIDIVE Announces Exclusive Dark Anime Release
content: In the anime streaming wars, there have been two major streaming services that pride themselves on focusing almost entirely on anime-only. One of them is Crunchyroll, which has been a platform for anime exclusives that has only grown bigger with each passing year.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Sequel Reveals Stacked Voice Cast Ahead of Netflix Debut
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is coming back to Netflix with a whole new batch of episodes, and the anime has revealed the new voice cast bringing all of its new characters to life. title: Bleach’s Final Season Just Had an Impressive Box Office Debut Weekend
content: Bleach is back in action with the fourth and final season of Thousand-Year Blood War this Summer, and its early premiere had an impressive box office weekend in the United States.
author: ComicBook

title: Hiroshi Shimomoto's Delinquent Gacha Manga Ends
content: Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ published the final chapter of Hiroshi Shimomoto 's Delinquent Gacha ( Gachankee ) manga on Tuesday. The third and final compiled book volume will ship on September 4. The manga had entered its last arc on June 16.
author: ANN

title: 10 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Major Shonen Hit Returns With a Special Theatrical Release
content: For several decades, Shonen has remained the most popular demographic in the anime and manga industry. However, even among all the classics and exciting new stories, only a small fraction have been able to earn praise throughout their run, especially the finale.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Anime Reveals Japanese/English Casts
content: The official website and X/Twitter account for the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime announced on Tuesday the Japanese and English casts. The staff also confirmed that the first episode will premiere at this year's Anime Expo event on Friday at 7:30 p.m. PDT at the Crypto.com Arena.
author: ANN

title: OceanVeil to Stream Perfect Addiction 'Light Anime'
content: The anime will premiere on July 8 on tvk at 11:25 p.m. JST, and will stream early on the same day at 10:00 p.m. JST on d Anime Store , AnimeFesta , and Anime Times . The anime stars Yōhei Azakami as Akihito Kuji (left in image at right), and Sōma Saitō as Sae Takatsuki.
author: ANN
